title: news_feeds.recent
description: Get recent articles aggregated from the node's configured RSS/Atom feeds, ordered by published_at desc. Optionally filter to one or more categories and / or urgency buckets.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return. Default 20 if omitted.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 datetime. Only articles with published_at >= since are returned.

category.description: Optional category filter. A single category string, or an array of 1–7 unique category strings. Articles whose category is in the resulting set are returned. Omit to return across all categories. Unknown categories are rejected by Core before the handler runs.

urgency.description: Optional urgency filter. A single urgency bucket, or an array of 1–3 unique buckets. Articles whose urgency is in the resulting set are returned. Buckets are computed deterministically at fetch time by the node's scorer (no LLM); 'high' approximates breaking-news status. Omit to return across all buckets. AND-combines with the category filter when both are present — e.g. category='tech' + urgency='high' returns high-urgency tech articles only.
